method: BASELINE. Seat-neutral core in the Code's own actors and terms, with regulative rules where the text states duties, and a taxpayer seat layer built from it; written straight from the deposited text with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (parts not encoded answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Iowa Code 2026 (Legislative Services Agency; laws through the 2025 regular session), chapter 422, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ia-code-ch-422-2026.txt (retrieved 2026-10-19). 2026 session Acts not applied. No instrument brought in.

checks.command: l4 run ia-income-tax.l4 ; l4 run ia-income-tax-seat.l4 ; l4 run ia-income-tax-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Iowa Code 422.4(9), (14), (15); 422.5(1)(a), (2), (3), (11); 422.7 opening words and subsections 1, 2, 8, 19(a), 20, 29 (other adjustments as inputs); 422.12(2)(a), (b); 422.12B; 422.12C(1), (2)(a), (3); 422.13(1), (2); 422.21(1); 422.24(1). Not covered (asserted): married filing separately, nonresident and part-year tax, the credit for tax paid to another state, the combat-zone extension. Out: business credits, lump sums, S corporation proration, withholding duties, penalties. Read with subjects/us/internal-revenue-code-of-1986/ for the federal inputs.
seat: the individual taxpayer (resident or nonresident; single, joint, head of household or surviving spouse)
